settings.hdmi_rotation_help: Rotates the entire Pi X11 desktop and browser, not just the player page. Apply separately from display settings. Keep player Screen rotation at Normal to avoid rotating twice. The saved HDMI setting is restored at kiosk startup when configured. Touchscreen input is not remapped.
settings.hdmi_rotation_unavailable: HDMI rotation needs the X11 kiosk setup: xrandr, HDMI_ROTATION_OUTPUT, DISPLAY and permission to access the kiosk X session. See the Raspberry Pi deployment guide. Wayland is not supported.
settings.hdmi_rotation_failed: Unable to rotate the HDMI display. Check the connected output, X11 permissions and server logs. If saving failed, verify the physical display orientation before retrying.
settings.rotation_help: Rotates the player screen and live preview, including hints and videos. Staff pages and the Pi desktop are unchanged. Save to apply immediately; choose Normal to restore.
settings.rotation_invalid: Screen rotation must be 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
media.title: Fonts & media
media.description: Optional local media. Background video yields to video hints and briefings; music plays only during a running timer and pauses for audio/video hints.
media.upload_limit: Maximum combined upload per save: {limit} MB. Pi 3: use H.264 MP4 at 720p/24–30 fps and keep the image background as a fallback.
media.invalid_settings: Invalid saved media settings. Media features are disabled; save valid settings to repair them.
media.remove: Remove this file (also uncheck its enabled option)
media.enable_soundtrack: Enable looping soundtrack while timer runs
media.enable_briefing: Play briefing before starting the timer
media.briefing_help: When selected, Start (including GPIO) plays the briefing first. The timer starts after successful playback ends. Staff can skip and start, or cancel. Playback errors never start the timer.
media.font_help: WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF, up to 2 MiB. Only upload fonts you have permission to use. Browser loading errors retain the system font.
media.briefing_active: Briefing active. Timer has not started. Use the player screen to check playback, or explicitly skip or cancel below.
media.confirm_briefing_reset: A briefing is already playing. Resetting will cancel it without starting the timer. Are you sure?
media.font_failed: Custom font could not load. Using the system font.
media.finish_failed: Briefing ended, but timer start could not be confirmed. Retry or use staff controls.
media.background_failed: Video background unavailable. Using the image/colour background.
media.soundtrack_failed: Soundtrack could not play. Click Retry playback or disable it in staff settings.
media.briefing_failed: Briefing could not play. Retry playback, or ask staff to skip or cancel. Timer has not started.
media.briefing_disabled: Briefing pending, but media is disabled on this screen. Ask staff to skip or cancel.
layout.title: Screen editor
layout.description: Drag blocks to move them and drag the yellow corner to resize. Changes affect only this preview until you save.
layout.lightweight: This lightweight 16:9 preview uses placeholders, not video or image decoders. Check the saved layout on the actual TV; fullscreen hints and end-of-game screens keep their original layout.
layout.current_custom: The player screen is using a custom layout.
layout.current_default: The player screen is using the original default layout.
layout.stored_error: The saved layout is invalid. The original screen is being used. Save a valid layout to repair it.
layout.server_disabled: Custom layouts are disabled by DISABLE_CUSTOM_LAYOUT on the server. Saved designs will not be applied until that override is removed.
layout.no_script: The editor needs JavaScript. You can still use the default-screen button below.
layout.resize: Resize selected block with arrow keys or by dragging
layout.keyboard_help: Select a block and use arrow keys to move it; focus the yellow corner to resize with arrow keys. Shift makes larger steps. Hidden blocks appear faintly in the editor.
layout.hint_fallback: Text-only hints always keep their text. Media without a caption remains visible even in text-only mode.
layout.unavailable: The editor is unavailable. The live screen is unchanged; the default-screen button still works.
layout.invalid: Invalid properties. Keep blocks inside the screen.
layout.unsaved: Unsaved changes — the player screen is unchanged.
layout.pointer_fallback: Dragging is unavailable. Use the property fields or keyboard arrows instead.
layout.discarded: Edits discarded. The player screen is unchanged.
layout.saved: Layout saved and applied to the player screen.
layout.saved_disabled: Layout saved, but the server override is keeping the default screen active.
language.label: Language
donate.message: Enjoying the software? Donations are welcome, never required.
admin.change_display: Change display text, colours, and background image.
admin.edit_help: Drag a control card to rearrange it, then select Done editing.
admin.no_actions: No actions recorded for this run.
login.title: Admin login
login.password_changed: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
settings.title: Display settings
settings.timer_duration_description: Saved for the next start. Running and paused timers keep their current duration.
settings.image_preview_error: Image preview could not be loaded. Try a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
settings.heading: Heading
settings.password_description: Changing the password signs out all current admin sessions.
settings.password_too_short: The new password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
settings.password_unchanged: The new password must be different from the current password.
users.title: User management
users.description: Standard users can use all room controls and settings but cannot manage user accounts.
users.invalid_username: Usernames must be 3–32 characters and use only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.
users.username_exists: A user with that username already exists.
users.use_personal_password_form: Change your own password from the display settings page.
sounds.title: Event sounds
hints.title: Hint library
hints.full_screen: Show full screen when sent (image/video only)
gpio.title: GPIO settings
gpio.unavailable: GPIO hardware is unavailable on this host.
gpio.link: Link a BCM pin to an event
gpio.extra_description: Create a button that sends the selected signal to a configured GPIO output.
gpio.no_outputs: Configure a GPIO output before creating an extra button.
gpio.trigger_event_description: Create an extra button to turn a BCM GPIO pin on or off, toggle it, or turn it on for a chosen duration. Timed signals restart on each click; other signals cancel the countdown. Multiple buttons can control the same output pin.
announcement.title: Two-minute announcement
announcement.no_matches: No saved hints match this search.
timer.title: Room timer
timer.already_started: The timer has already started. Reset it before starting a new run.
timer.description: Add time extends the total time available without affecting time taken. Remove time adds a penalty to time taken without affecting the total time.
stats.title: Room statistics
stats.confirm_delete: Delete the leaderboard entry for {team}? This cannot be undone and will update the completion statistics.
stats.description: Completed rooms rank before failed rooms, then by time remaining, penalties, and hints.
js.confirm_timer_reset: A room timer is already in progress. Are you sure you want to reset it? This will stop the current run.
js.valid_seconds: Enter a valid number of seconds.
js.valid_adjustment: Enter minutes and seconds from 0 to 59, with at least one above zero.
js.no_actions: No actions recorded for this run.
